_comment: Quality gate for every hotel the site recommends. Scales are NOT interchangeable — apply the floor native to whichever source supplied the score. Never convert between them.
notes: Google's 5-pt floors are stricter than a mechanical halving of the 10-pt floors, on purpose: Google ratings are compressed (most decent hotels sit 3.9-4.6) and accept reviews from non-guests.
High tier stops at 4.6 not 4.7 — Google penalises expensive hotels via non-guest reviews in a way Booking's verified-stay system does not.
Blocked until the Travelpayouts hotel programs unlock (~Oct 2026). Config lives here now so the filter is ready on day one.
